findings.finding: Lite U2 TPS54302 (and core U2 USBLC6-2SC6) use the EasyEDA SOT-23-6_L2.9-W1.6-P0.95-LS2.8-BL footprint: pad rows 2.30 mm c-c with 1.072 mm pads, vs TI DDC0006A example land pattern rows 2.7 mm with 1.1 x 0.6 mm pads. Pads end 1.69 mm from centre vs TI 1.90; lead tips at 1.30-1.50 mm so toe fillet is 0.19-0.39 mm instead of ~0.4-0.6 mm.
findings.evidence: TI SLVSDG6C p30 (DDC0006A, 4214841/E): 6X(1.1) 6X(0.6) (2.7); footprint pads 0.532x1.072 at y=+/-1.15 (lite-main.kicad_pcb U2)
findings.fix: Optional: replace with a DDC0006A land pattern (pads 1.1 x 0.6 at +/-1.35 mm) when the board is next touched; not required for the first spin.
findings.margin: lead foot fully on pad; toe 0.19-0.39 mm

findings.finding: CH224Q U1 pad 10 (PG, open-drain output) is on net GND in core.kicad_pcb but unconnected in the netlist/schematic: schematic-PCB parity break. Electrically harmless (OD output, nothing reads PG on core).
findings.evidence: core.kicad_pcb U1 pad 10 (net GND) vs core.net node unconnected-(U1-PG-Pad10); WCH CH224DS1 V2.0 Table 4-1 (PG = OD)
findings.fix: Make schematic and PCB agree: either tie PG to GND in blocks.py (explicit) or clear the pad net and add a no-connect flag; rerun KiCad parity/DRC.

findings.finding: ES9018K2M runs from internal DVDD with a 50 MHz MCLK (Y1). The datasheet requires external 1.3 V DVDD when MCLK > 50 MHz: the design sits exactly on the limit, and oscillator tolerance (+/-50-100 ppm) can put it above.
findings.evidence: ESS ES9018K2M datasheet v3.7 p7 DVDD Supply: internal DVDD except PCM: MCLK > 50MHz; Y1 = C717684 OT322550MJBA4SL 50 MHz
findings.fix: Swap Y1 to a 49.152 MHz 3.3 V CMOS 3225 oscillator, e.g. C7431354 SX3M49.152B10F20TNN (verify its pin 1 = OE, 2 GND, 3 OUT, 4 VDD against Y1 before the swap); 1.7 % margin and synchronous 1024 x 48 kHz. Keep 50 MHz Y2 for RMII.
findings.margin: 0 % (50.000 MHz vs > 50 MHz limit), negative by oscillator ppm

findings.finding: U17 is a TCA9555, which has internal ~100k pull-ups on every P-port (as strong as 33k: IIL -100 uA). From power-on until firmware configures it, the 100k pull-downs (R40,R41,R43,R44,R45) only make a divider: 1.65 V typ, 2.48 V worst. PHY_RST is Y2 OE (enable >=70% VDD or floating, disable <=30%), so Y2 can run at reset and put 50 MHz on ESP32 IO0 (boot strap) through R60, making the boot mode random. PVDD_EN reaches the 2N7002 gate at 1.1-2.0 V (VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V), so PVDD can switch on before firmware. Amp RESET and DAC_EN sit mid-rail.
findings.evidence: TI SCPS200E sect 5 (TCA9555 = TCA9535 + internal I/O pull-up), p16 schematic 100 kOhm, p6 IIL -100 uA; YXC YSO110TR p1 Tri-State thresholds; core.net PHY_RST: R45 100k to GND, U17 P05, Y2 pin1; ETH_CLK: Y2 via R60, U7 pin 25 IO0, Q5 C; JSCJ 2N7002 VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V
findings.fix: Swap U17 to TCA9535PWR (TI C130204, or UMW C22396388): same TSSOP-24 pinout, footprint and 0x20 address, no I/O pull-ups. Change R45 to 10k (oscillator OE has its own undocumented pull-up). Contingency: DNP 0R from Y2 pin 1 to GND. Bench-check that IO0 is quiet at EN rise.
findings.margin: PHY_RST 50-75 % VDD at boot vs <=30 % needed: negative

findings.finding: Proposed Lite J1 swap HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 (C165948) is rated 20 V; the Lite runs a 20 V PD contract, so 0 % margin on connector voltage rating (current GCT USB4105: 48 V). Footprint and pin order are compatible (BOM-only swap).
findings.evidence: HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 drawing rev A note 4-1 VOLTAGE RATING 20V; GCT USB4105 rev B3 48 V DC; lite R1 120k = 20 V request (WCH CH224 Table 5-1)
findings.fix: Prefer keeping USB4105-GF-A-120 (C5184243) on Lite; if cost forces HRO, accept with the note that SPR is <= 20 V +5 %.

findings.finding: Proposed core J1 swap GCT USB4085-GF-A (C7095263) is a through-hole (DIP) receptacle with 16 separate pins in two 0.85 mm staggered rows; it does not fit the current SMD USB-C-SMD_MC-311D footprint or the merged-pad symbol (A4-B9, A1-B12...).
findings.evidence: GCT USB4085 drawing rev B sheet 1-2: Dip Type PCB Top Mount, 16x 0.40 holes in 0.65 pads, slots 0.6x2.1/0.6x1.4 at 8.65
findings.fix: If the swap is made: new 16-pin symbol (VBUS A4/A9/B4/B9 and GND A1/A12/B1/B12 tied in schematic) and a footprint from GCT sheet 2 with pads enlarged to ~0.70 mm (annulus 0.15 mm; 0.15 mm pad gap at 0.85 pitch) and rerun DRC/fp_verify; otherwise keep USB4105 (C5184243) whose footprint is verified.

findings.finding: Ultra U19 is ordered as PLR237/T8BK (C17223620) but placed on an EasyEDA PLR237-T10BK footprint (C17427482). The T8 lead form needs two 1.70 mm locating-peg holes (5.60 mm apart, 2.61 mm forward of the 1.10 mm post holes) that the footprint lacks, so the part cannot seat. The symbol also numbers 1 VCC / 3 VOUT, reverse of Everlight (1 Vout, 2 GND, 3 Vcc); physical pad positions appear to compensate but are unverified.
findings.evidence: Everlight PLR237/T8BK DPL-0000263 Rev.1 p5 pin function + PCB layout (3x0.80, 2x1.10 at 5.08, 2x1.70 at 5.60); core/lib/aiee.pretty/OPTO-TH_PLR237-T10BK.kicad_mod (5 holes only, LCSC tag C17427482)
findings.fix: Either order PLR237/T10BK (C17427482) that the footprint was made for and check its pinout vs its own Everlight datasheet, or add 2x NPTH 1.70 mm at x=+/-2.80, 2.61 mm forward of the 1.10 mm holes for the T8BK. In both cases renumber the symbol to Everlight (1 Vout, 2 GND, 3 Vcc) and confirm pad-1 position vs the vendor drawing before release.

findings.finding: BZT52C33 symbol pins are named 1/2 instead of K/A; polarity is correct (pad 1 = cathode band = VBUS) but not visible on the schematic.
findings.evidence: BORN BZT52Cxx p1 (color band = cathode); SOD-123 footprint cathode bar at pad 1
findings.fix: Rename symbol pins to K (1) / A (2).
